assumptions.model: tau_chi dot chi + chi = alpha F(t)

polynomial_obstruction_order_3.polynomial_identity: Omega**4*d3*tau_chi + Omega**3*(-I*d2*tau_chi - I*d3) + Omega**2*(-d1*tau_chi - d2) + Omega*(I*d0*tau_chi + I*d1) - alpha + d0

rows.notes: The cos component alone is not novel; it can be absorbed into a frequency-local static amplitude.

rows.drive_scope: single monochromatic drive with finite Omega tau_chi
rows.notes: The unmatched quadrature is proportional to alpha c_chi F0 Omega tau_chi/(1+Omega^2 tau_chi^2).

rows.comparator_basis: local derivative basis {F, dot F} with free coefficients
rows.notes: At one frequency, a0 F + a1 dot F fits both quadratures. This does not prove a dynamical internal state.
rows.projection_result: one derivative coefficient fits the quadrature exactly

rows.absorption_target: derivative Wilson coefficients through order N
